records.subject: You're in -- let's get Granite Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for the update — glad the first week has gone well, and it was good to talk at the kickoff. Nothing is open on your side right now, so this is just a quick nudge on one thing: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the product tends to click once real work is sitting in a project alongside your teammate.

If it's useful, I can walk you through that first step on a short call this week — happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Nadia
